name: Medicine (MD/DO student)
scope: Takes a focused or complete history, performs a physical examination, orders and interprets investigations, forms a differential diagnosis and a management plan under supervision.

wrapUp.label: One-line summary of the patient
wrapUp.placeholder: e.g. 59M with HFrEF presenting with early satiety and weight loss...

wrapUp.label: Assessment and differential diagnosis (most likely first, with reasoning)
Plan: investigations, treatment, patient education, follow-up

rubricEmphasis: History taking, clinical reasoning, differential diagnosis, safe management, shared decision making.

name: Dietetics / Clinical Nutrition
scope: Conducts nutrition assessment (diet history, anthropometrics, labs, barriers), makes a nutrition diagnosis, and delivers patient-centred nutrition education and counselling using motivational interviewing.

wrapUp.label: Intervention, patient goals agreed, monitoring and evaluation

rubricEmphasis: Motivational interviewing, cultural humility, plain-language education, realistic goal setting.

name: Nursing (RN)
scope: Performs a nursing assessment, monitors and interprets vital signs, identifies safety risks, provides patient education, and escalates concerns to the provider using SBAR.

wrapUp.label: Nursing assessment: priority findings and risks
Nursing interventions and patient education provided
SBAR to the provider (if escalation is needed)

rubricEmphasis: Systematic assessment, patient safety, recognition of deterioration, therapeutic communication, escalation.
